name: calendario-familiar-android
description: Android (Capacitor) wrapper of the family calendar web app in ../calendario

scripts.build:android: npm run copy-web && cap sync android
scripts.apk: npm run build:android && cd android && CAL_VERSION_NAME=$(node -p "require('../package.json').version") CAL_VERSION_CODE=$(node ../scripts/version-code.js) ./gradlew assembleDebug
